name: Credit Transfer Context 1
definition: Context of a credit transfer transaction.

AutomaticNotificationOfCashMovement.name: Automatic Notification Of Cash Movement
AutomaticNotificationOfCashMovement.definition: Indicator that specifies if a notification is expected after a credit transfer request. | Usage: When absent, default value is False.

WaitForNotificationBeforeEnding.name: Wait For Notification Before Ending
WaitForNotificationBeforeEnding.definition: Indicator from the sale system to the accepting system to wait for notification before stating that the payment is done.|  Usage: When absent, default value is False.

SystemToNotify.name: System To Notify
SystemToNotify.definition: Reference of the system that should receive the notification of credit transfer.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Information related to the payer's account.

ProtectedDebtorAccount.name: Protected Debtor Account
ProtectedDebtorAccount.definition: Secured information related to the debtor's account.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Information related to the payee's account.

ProtectedCreditorAccount.name: Protected Creditor Account
ProtectedCreditorAccount.definition: Secured information related to the creditor's account.

OneElementPresenceRule.definition: At least one of these subelements mut be present.
